blockingFindings.title: Docs traversal exclusion scope is not tested
blockingFindings.rationale: This is a must requirement with no corresponding test coverage for the policy-scope behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires the `freshness-source` exclusions to apply only to sourceRoot traversal and docs/ to be traversed without source exclusions. The tests prove docs/ can hit a normal file limit, but they never place a source-excluded path such as `docs/.senti`, `docs/node_modules`, or `docs/specs/.../review-evidence` under docs/. An implementation that incorrectly applies `freshness-source` to docsScan would still pass these tests.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local unit test where an otherwise source-excluded directory under docs/ contains more than the maxFiles budget and assert the result is `indeterminate` with `docsScan.policy === "default"`.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: This is a must requirement with no corresponding test coverage for the policy-scope behavior.
